summary: A trader lost more than two hundred thousand dollars after attackers gained direct signing control over wallets originally created through the SIGMA Telegram trading bot ecosystem. The wallets were manually drained across Ethereum Base and BSC and investigators suspected private key compromise through phishing malware or insecure wallet generation workflows.
user_mistake: generated or imported wallets through Telegram trading bot infrastructure
prevention: avoid storing significant funds in Telegram generated wallets/use dedicated hardware wallets for high value holdings
